item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"piece_id":"03","ready":false,"issues":["Startup-watch requirement unmet: no AI-native startup is featured with a build, buy, or wait implication.","Series podcast-evidence requirement remains unmet; limitations flags the gap but the brief cannot satisfy the required cross-format coverage.","Claim 03-c4 is labeled reported_fact although it relies on a PTC-authored demonstration; classify the claimed robustness outcome as source_claim or limit it to what the video visibly demonstrates.","Synthesis overstates the PTC example by saying robustness can be deliberately encoded; one vendor tutorial demonstrates one workflow and provides no comparative robustness evidence.","The argument’s broad recommendation to treat agentic features as assistive systems is reasonable inference, but it lacks a claim-level evidence reference tying that recommendation to the cited checks."]}
